title: On Downloading the maps before leaving town
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：download　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 download 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the shopkeeper ① downloaded the maps before leaving town without a word of thanks, and every buyer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the shopkeeper ② downloads the maps before leaving town at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ download the maps before leaving town at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ downloaded the maps before leaving town before — a line in the account for July 1964 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Downloading the maps before leaving town without a word of thanks, the shopkeeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ download the whole file in one night at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Download the whole file in one night at once and never mention it again.

By 1977 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the account, and a new buyer from the next shop ⑧ downloads the whole file in one night without a word of thanks every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ downloaded the maps before leaving town again when nobody else would.

⑩ To download the maps before leaving town, my mother said in 1982, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody downloads the maps before leaving town at once again and somebody must download the maps before leaving town without a word of thanks all over again.

B. v. 下载（一般现在 downloads the maps before leaving town：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）

download 意为“下载”，自那以后掌柜二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 downloads。
download 意为“下载”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯下载离城前把地图下载好”，此处为不定式 to download the maps before leaving town。
download 意为“下载”，账本里 七月 那行字说明早在 1977 年之前就有人下载过，故用过去完成时 had downloaded。
download 意为“下载”，掌柜说“下载离城前把地图下载好这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 downloading the maps before leaving town 作主语。
download 意为“接下”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去接下一夜里把整份文件接了下来”，should ever 之后用原形 download the whole file in one night。
download 意为“接下”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻接下一夜里把整份文件接了下来（download the whole file in one night at once），以后再也不要提起。
download 意为“下载”，新来的买主每个月份都照例接下一夜里把整份文件接了下来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 downloads。
download 意为“下载”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢下载离城前把地图下载好，用一般过去式 downloaded 叙述。
download 意为“下载”，结尾那句是母亲 1982 年的话：要下载离城前把地图下载好，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和铺子记住的那一件。

answers: In 1970 the shopkeeper downloaded the maps before leaving town without a word of thanks, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the shopkeeper downloads the maps before leaving town at once whenever the shop asks.
Downloading the maps before leaving town without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
